pages.text: The second step of CyberFarm power: $(l)gases$(). Organic waste, pressed into Biomass, becomes $(l)Biogas$(), mobs shut in an extraction chamber give off $(l)Methane$(), and a $(l)Gas Turbine$() burns both into FE.$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/biomass_press)Biomass Press$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l)

$(li)$(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipe$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l)Biogas$(): $(l:generators/bio_digester)Bio-Digester$(/l), 10 mB/t, 5 FE per mB, 9 FE per mB$(br)$(li)$(l)Methane$(): $(l:generators/methane_extractor)Methane Extractor$(/l), up to 50 mB/t, 12 FE per mB, 15 FE per mB$(br)The Gas Turbine is small and cheap; the $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l) is a bigger build that gets more out of every mB.

pages.title: How long gas lasts
pages.text: A bucket is 1,000 mB. A Gas Turbine burns 20 mB/t, a Steam Engine 45 mB/t.$(br)$(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Biogas$(): Gas Turbine 5,000 FE, 2.5 seconds at 100 FE/t; Steam Engine 9,000 FE, about 1.1 seconds at 405 FE/t$(br)$(li)$(l)1,000 mB of Methane$(): Gas Turbine 12,000 FE, 2.5 seconds at 240 FE/t; Steam Engine 15,000 FE, about 1.1 seconds at 675 FE/t

$(li)$(l)One Biomass$() (500 mB of Biogas): 2,500 FE in a Gas Turbine, 4,500 FE in a Steam Engine$(br)$(li)$(l)One zombie in the chamber$() (300,000 mB): 3,600,000 FE in a Gas Turbine, 4,500,000 FE in a Steam Engine

Gas is made slowly and burned fast: what counts is the flow. One Gas Turbine at full power needs 20 mB/t, that is $(l)two Bio-Digesters$() or two fifths of a zombie chamber; a Steam Engine needs 45 mB/t, a little less than one zombie chamber.
Gases can be carried in buckets, held $(l)upside down$() since they are lighter than air:
pages.title: Gas buckets

pages.text: $(li)$(l)Fill one$(): right-click a machine or tank holding at least 1,000 mB of gas with an $(l)empty bucket$() (a Bio-Digester for Biogas, a Methane Outlet of the extraction chamber for Methane, a reactor port or turbine for Steam).

$(li)$(l)Empty it$(): right-click a machine, a Reactor Port or a tank of any mod to pour the 1,000 mB in.$(br)$(li)A gas cannot be poured into the world: it would just float away.$(br)$(li)$(item)Biogas Bucket$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Methane Bucket$()$(br)$(li)$(item)Steam Bucket$()
Both gases are $(l)standard fluids$(): tanks, pipes and machines of other mods that handle fluids can store and move them too. They are tagged forge:gaseous, forge:biogas and forge:methane.

The Biomass Press and the Bio-Digester draw 8 FE/t each, so the first power has to come from elsewhere, such as a $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l). At full speed a digester and one press cost 16 FE/t together, while their gas gives 50 FE/t in a Gas Turbine, or 90 in a Steam Engine.

A typical setup: a Bio-Digester and the Methane Outlet of an extraction chamber push their gas into $(l:cables/gas_pipe)Gas Pipes$(/l), which carry it to a $(l:generators/gas_turbine)Gas Turbine$(/l) or a $(l:generators/steam_engine)Steam Engine$(/l); they push FE into $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduits$(/l) that power your drones' docks.
